request: Should we move our five services into one monorepo?
facts: A change to the shared library needs five coordinated pull requests today; this happened nine times last quarter.
Nobody on the team has set up path-based CI triggers before; without them every commit builds all five services (about 25 minutes).
Two of the five services belong to another team, which has said it prefers separate repositories.
The migration is estimated at two weeks. Splitting the repositories again later is possible but loses the merged history.
The services are deployed independently and that would not change.
note: A balanced trade-off: the three perspectives should not all land on the same side. Unanimous runs here are a sign that the units are converging.
